newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse on Wednesday consolidated its upward trend due mainly to interest in the largest companies, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 435.85 points, up 0.11 percent over the previous session.
"The market pursued its upward trend due largely to active trading in ONA Group and Wafabank," a stockbroker at the Casablanca-based Maroc Inter Titres said.
ONA, Morocco's largest private conglomerate which has diversified stakes in 100 companies, jumped eight dirhams to close at 485 dirhams, he said.
ONA's managers are expected to announce on Thursday the company's half-year consolidated results, the broker said.

The conglomerate's listed subsidiaries sugar refinery Cosumar, agro-industry Centrale Laitiere, edible oil firm Lesieur and Financiere Diwan posted a positive results in the first half of 1996 compared with the same period last year.
The traded volume on the official market was 20.5 million dirhams compared with 30.8 million on Tuesday.
